articles.description: Sonia Gandhi’s memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love, has triggered a political row over her account of the Emergency. articles.title: 'EGO, RESENTMENT': Hegseth Goes NUCLEAR Over Impeachment Threat, BLASTS Massie In Furious SHOWDOWN
articles.description: U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Tuesday launched a furious attack on the impeachment effort against him, branding it a “farce”, a “stunt” and a “political spectacle” driven by “ego and resentment”. Speaking at his first Pentagon press briefing since May, Hegseth accused Republican Congressman Thomas Massie of using his final days in Congress to damage President Donald Trump, the administration and the military. Massie has introduced an impeachment resolution accusing Hegseth of serious misconduct over his handling of the Iran war and other military operations involving Yemen and Venezuela. Defending his leadership, Hegseth argued that no U.S. defence secretary has ever been impeached for carrying out lawful military operations.

articles.title: Diwali In WA: White House Celebrates, Far-Right Activists Storm Seattle Festival | Hard Facts
articles.description: Two sharply contrasting scenes unfolded in the United States during Diwali 2026. At the White House, President Donald Trump marked the festival with the traditional lighting of a diya at the Oval Office. In Olympia, Washington Governor Bob Ferguson joined the Consulate General of India and members of the Indian-American community for a Diwali celebration at the State Capitol, recognising the community's cultural heritage and contributions to the state. But just days later, the festival's message of light, inclusion and togetherness faced a very different response in Seattle. On November 7, two far-right activists, identified as Jake Lang and Thomas Allen, disrupted the free “Diwali: Lights of India” festival at the Seattle Center Armory.
